signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: Produktly may modify or discontinue any part of the Service at its discretion.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: They are not priced per team member or per monthly active user: each plan includes a monthly number of triggers (2,000, 7,500 or 50,000+) and team members (3, 20 or 50+).

We will ask you to upgrade your plan, or unpublish features. If you exceed the quota significantly, and don't upgrade, we will stop serving the features for the rest of the month until your quota resets.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 8 reviews (20.5% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: the app doesn't work and they have not been responding for months
Cant get through to company for over 3 weeks.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 3.6/5 vs 4.08/5 all-time (-0.48). 21% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $79 vs a stated $900 regular price (91% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to Produktly Plan
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Produktly Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let Produktly discontinue the service at its discretion and revoke access on termination, which materially limits the promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Produktly may modify or discontinue any part of the Service at its discretion.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves the right to discontinue the service, which voids any promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Upon termination, access to the Service will be revoked, and any stored data may be deleted.
exhibits.argument: Access can be revoked on termination, so lifetime access is not guaranteed.

trials.reasoning: The vendor's pricing lists Unlimited Product tours and a buyer confirms tours work; the quota and quality complaints do not limit how many tours can be created.

exhibits.quote: If you exceed the quota significantly, and don't upgrade, we will stop serving the features for the rest of the month until your quota resets.
exhibits.argument: Features stop serving when trigger quota is exceeded, so product tours are not truly unlimited.

exhibits.argument: Buyer reports product tours do not work properly, undermining the included unlimited tours claim.
